source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "digital payments" AND (vendors OR merchants OR "small businesses" OR informal OR urban)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"digital payments" AND (vendors OR merchants OR "small businesses" OR informal OR urban),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital payments" AND ("small businesses" OR "informal" OR "merchants" OR "urban" OR "vendors"))
